# Character Sheet

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Terminology](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#CharacterSheet)*

A character sheet is a paper or digital record that you use to track your character's information. *See also* ["Creating a Character"](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/creating-a-character#ChooseaCharacterSheet).
